script_text: The cosmic storm hits early — and Jupiter in your 10th House won't give Pisces an easy week. Monday brings a tense square between Neptune, ruler of your sign, and Saturn in your 7th House, making communication rocky until Wednesday's trine from Venus to your Midheaven smooths career waters. Tuesday feels heavy — delay big conversations or legal matters. Wednesday is your power day because Venus trines your Midheaven, boosting professional visibility and financial opportunities. Thursday's full moon sextile Pluto in your 8th House reshapes shared resources or intimate bonds. Love prediction: Friday's Venus-Neptune conjunction lights up your 5th House — romantic timing is flawless. Career prediction: Tuesday's Saturn-Neptune square tests workplace alliances; hold steady. Weekend brings intuitive clarity — trust your gut on money moves. Follow for daily updates.
